subject.title: [AI-assisted] Preserve thread sessions across daily reset by default

question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessionClosedAt` as a durable core `SessionEntry` lifecycle field, reserved from plugin slot collisions, for externally closed channel threads?
rationale: The marker is not confined to Discord: it alters persisted state and session freshness decisions across core reply, Gateway, command, cron, and plugin-runtime paths. Code review can establish mechanics, but maintainers must choose the permanent ownership and compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept a scoped core lifecycle marker
options.body: Keep `sessionClosedAt` as a generic core field after the branch is rebased, unrelated drift is removed, and exact-head proof confirms the existing default and explicit continuity behavior.

options.title: Require a narrower owner contract
options.body: Ask for a channel/plugin-owned mechanism if maintainers do not want external-close state represented in the shared session entry.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or defer the PR if the durable lifecycle contract is not worth maintaining across every session resolver.

recommendation.title: Accept a scoped core lifecycle marker
recommendation.body: Keep `sessionClosedAt` as a generic core field after the branch is rebased, unrelated drift is removed, and exact-head proof confirms the existing default and explicit continuity behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor explicitly identified this person for the unresolved durable-session-state decision.
